fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng confirmed accurate (geocode moved 1042 m, ROOFTOP). Plant centered ~43.0793,-94.2233 — a single ~150,000 sq ft pepperoni/sausage plant on the SW edge of Algona, IA, accessed by a private road off the public road to the north.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at the public-road junction — the entrance is an open driveway with Hormel signage (Street View 2025-08). No continuous perimeter fence around the property. A small structure sits beside the ~250 m private access road (~43.0807,-94.2241) which could be a small check-in/booth, but no controlled barrier is visible. Classified false; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear staffed booth at a controlled entrance. The small roadside structure on the access road is ambiguous at z20 — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The private access road is ~250 m long and easily holds a queue of 3+ trucks before reaching the yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 10-25 band — modest-sized single plant; dock doors with a few trailers backed in on the east/center building face. Overhead estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: ~6-8 trailers parked in the NE yard area; no large dedicated drop lot. 0-10 band.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits on the SW edge of Algona (pop ~5,500) surrounded by farmland — Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line passes near the SE property edge but no spur runs into the plant; classified false.
